summary: Backend testing for Zim Link admin calling module (iteration 2). 25/25 tests passed covering admin auth & guard, call rates CRUD, /voice/rate-quote, wallet billing on /voice/call-log (success + insufficient balance), admin stats aggregation, admin calls list, admin user credit, non-admin 403 enforcement, and regression of existing flows.

minor.issue: Allows negative amounts (used for tests). Should validate amount > 0 in production to prevent admin from setting wallet < 0; current logic could create negative balances and break atomic billing guarantees.
max_minutes returns null for free/in-app rates; frontend should handle null. Also no validation that 'to' is a valid E.164 string; empty string still returns a default rate.

Accepts arbitrary client-supplied duration_seconds (capped at 4h) without any cross-check against Twilio call records. Acceptable for current trust model but should be flagged for future fraud-prevention work.
by_day groups by ISO date substring (UTC). Top callers limit hardcoded to 5; consider param.
No brute-force lockout / rate-limit. (Out of scope for this iteration but flagged from playbook check.)

action_items: Consider adding amount > 0 validation on /api/admin/users/{id}/credit (or expose explicit debit endpoint).
Optional: add E.164 validation on rate-quote 'to' param.
Optional: add login brute-force lockout (playbook recommendation).
No blocking issues - all requested features pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 800 lines and growing; consider splitting routers (auth, wallet, marketplace, community, voice, admin) into separate modules under /app/backend/routers/.
get_rate_for_number does a full collection scan per call; fine at current scale but cache or use sorted index on prefix length for high QPS.

Billing in /api/voice/call-log is atomic on the user balance update (good), but the calls insert happens regardless of billing outcome. Consider also writing a wallet 'debit' transaction record for parity with /wallet/transactions audit trail.
ADMIN_PASSWORD is in plaintext in backend/.env; acceptable for a dev seed credential but should be documented as such.
/api/admin/users/{id}/credit accepts a raw dict instead of a Pydantic model — switch to a CreditIn(BaseModel) with amount: float = Field() and a positive bound.
test_credentials: admin@superapp.com/admin123 and user@superapp.com/user123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Both work; admin user has is_admin=true after on_startup backfill.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary registered user (TEST_lowbal_*@example.com) for the insufficient-balance test; one TEST_Region rate created and deleted within the same test. No persistent test data pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin calling-module backend APIs are working. Iteration-2 test file at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_calling.py uses Bearer token auth. user@superapp.com balance fluctuates during tests (credited +25 each run + small billing deductions). Re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_calling.py -v`. Frontend admin UI (AdminDashboard.jsx, AdminRates.jsx, AdminGuard.jsx) was NOT tested per request scope.
